compute_budget: CPU only, <=5 minutes; no refitting; 675 OOF rows, five existing folds, six mock Agent calls
input_hash_canonicalization: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalized to LF; original files never rewritten

metric_definitions.abstain_rate: 0 by diagnostic construction, not an empirical Assurance result
metric_definitions.budget: floor(N*budget) highest scores, ties broken by observation_id; does not exceed budget
metric_definitions.consistency: fraction of equal unordered run pairs; evidence mean pairwise Jaccard, empty union NOT_ESTIMABLE
metric_definitions.coverage: issued / all observations; all equal confidence ties included at threshold
metric_definitions.fold_error: fixed-threshold OOF misclassification on each existing outer test fold, no seed sensitivity/refit claim
metric_definitions.issued: Diagnostic PASS/FLAG predictions at fixed 0.5; not Assurance authorization
metric_definitions.precision: events in reviewed rows / reviewed rows
metric_definitions.recall: events in reviewed rows / all historical events
metric_definitions.selective_error: wrong issued predictions / issued; zero issued is NOT_ESTIMABLE, never correct abstention
